facts.statement: Zhanghenglong was an extinct herbivorous dinosaur belonging to the hadrosauroid iguanodont group.
facts.quote: Zhanghenglong is an extinct genus of herbivorous hadrosauroid iguanodont dinosaur

facts.statement: The genus contains only one species, Zhanghenglong yangchengensis, known from a partial and disarticulated skull and postcranial skeleton.
facts.quote: It contains a single species, Zhanghenglong yangchengensis, represented by a disarticulated and partial cranium and postcranial skeleton.

facts.statement: Remains of a euornithopod were uncovered at Zhoujiagou in Henan province in 2011.
facts.quote: In 2011, at Zhoujiagou in Henan the remains were uncovered of a euornithopod.

facts.statement: The species Zhanghenglong yangchengensis was named and described in 2014 by a team including Xing Hai, Wang Deyou, Han Fenglu, Corwin Sullivan, Ma Qingyu, He Yiming, David Hone, Yan Ronghao, Du Fuming, and Xu Xing.
facts.quote: In 2014, the type species Zhanghenglong yangchengensis was named and described by Xing Hai, Wang Deyou, Han Fenglu, Corwin Sullivan, Ma Qingyu, He Yiming, David Hone, Yan Ronghao, Du Fuming and Xu Xing.

facts.statement: Zhanghenglong lived during the Late Cretaceous, specifically the middle Santonian stage.
facts.quote: It contains a single species, Zhanghenglong yangchengensis, represented by a disarticulated and partial cranium and postcranial skeleton.

facts.statement: Fossils of Zhanghenglong were found in the Majiacun Formation in Xixia County, Henan Province, China.
facts.quote: Zhanghenglong is an extinct genus of herbivorous hadrosauroid iguanodont dinosaur known from the Late Cretaceous (middle Santonian stage) Majiacun Formation in Xixia County of Henan Province, China.

facts.statement: Zhanghenglong differs significantly from other hadrosauroids by having two distinct autapomorphies: a strongly deflected posterior third of the maxilla and dentary teeth with specific ridge offsets.
facts.quote: The new genus and species significantly differs from other known members of Hadrosauroidea in having two distinct autapomorphies (strongly deflected posteroventrally posterior third of the maxilla relative to the anterior two thirds of it and dentary teeth with crowns of both median and distally offset primary ridges) and a unique combination of features.

facts.statement: Zhanghenglong lived between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: Only one species of Zhanghenglong is known, represented by a partial, disarticulated skull and postcranial remains.
facts.quote: Solo se conoce a una especie, representada por un cráneo desarticulado y parcial y restos del esqueleto postcraneal.
